adjudication.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb `retrieved_recently?` sets a Redis key `retrieved:#{@embed_url}` with a 60s TTL, so the throttle applies globally per embed URL for all non-`no_throttle` callers (staff can bypass). The comment `# Throttle other users to once every 60 seconds` can be read as a per-user throttle, which is not what the code does; it’s really “throttle retrieval for this URL for 60 seconds.” This is a specific, diff-grounded documentation/clarity issue rather than a verifiable functional defect.
